svg.title: General wiring
svg.desc: The whole machine: Nano, two ULN2003 boards with their 28BYJ-48, pen servo, joystick, LCD, SD card module and the external supply, with a Schottky diode on the Nano's 5V.

svg.text: CoreLR wiring overview (variant: a Schottky diode in series with the Nano's 5V)
Every wire of HwConfig.h in one picture; each subsystem is also drawn alone, as built (no diode). The SD module is the SD variant's (CORELR_JOB_SOURCE = sd).
LCD 2×16 + I²C backpack (A4 = SDA, A5 = SCL)
the USB 5 V and the external 5 V can no longer feed each other
+5 V (the external supply; to the Nano's 5V pin through the diode)

In SD mode the Nano's USB port is not connected: the Nano, the motors and the servo run from the external 5 V; the Nano from the same 5 V less the diode's drop (about 0.3 to 0.45 V); the LCD, the joystick and the SD module from the Nano's 5V pin. With the USB connected, whichever 5 V is higher feeds the Nano.
